# Your package protects revenue. Does it protect your take-home pay?

> Free calculator for independent personal trainers: compares a discounted prepaid session package against pay-per-session pricing on net take-home pay per hour, after your gym or studio's percentage cut or flat facility fee — not just revenue.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
